en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel, from Zarara, 
(It has been narrated) from one of the two<sup>asws</sup> (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said: ‘
Al-Mudabbar (one whose emancipation is conditional upon the death of the testator) is from the third’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Jamil from Zurarah who has narrated the following: “One of the two Imam, (abu Ja‘far or abu ‘ Abd Allah), ‘Alayhim al-Salam, has said,
‘Al-Mudabbar is from one-third of the legacy.’”
